mapper.insert: INSERT INTO moderator_operation_logs(moderator_id, operation_type, target_type, target_id, section_id, reason) values (#{moderatorId},#{operationType},#{targetType},#{targetId},#{sectionId},#{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT mol.id, -- 操作类型转换：将枚举值转换为中文描述 CASE mol.operation_type WHEN 'ban' THEN '封禁' WHEN 'unban' THEN '解封' WHEN 'pin' THEN '置顶' WHEN 'unpin' THEN '取消置顶' END AS operationType, -- 目标类型转换：将枚举值转换为中文描述 CASE mol.target_type WHEN 'post' THEN '帖子' WHEN 'user' THEN '用户' END AS targetType, -- 根据目标类型获取操作目标：帖子标题或用户名 CASE WHEN mol.target_type = 'post' THEN p.title WHEN mol.target_type = 'user' THEN u.username END AS operationTarget, -- 获取板块名称 s.name AS sectionName, -- 操作原因 mol.reason, -- 操作时间 mol.created_at AS createdAt FROM moderator_operation_logs mol -- 关联板块表获取板块名称 LEFT JOIN sections s ON mol.section_id = s.id -- 左连接帖子表（仅当目标类型为帖子时使用） LEFT JOIN posts p ON mol.target_type = 'post' AND mol.target_id = p.id -- 左连接用户表（仅当目标类型为用户时使用） LEFT JOIN users u ON mol.target_type = 'user' AND mol.target_id = u.id WHERE mol.section_id = #{sectionId} ORDER BY mol.created_at DESC
